findings.title: Qualification gate manufactures decisive status instead of deriving it from bound observations
findings.reachability: Qualification mechanism cited by CURRENT release documentation
findings.counterexample: Dirty worktree still produced SOURCE_BOUND_MACHINE_GATE=PASS and NX069_STATUS=PASS; persisted PASS report contains PYTEST_FAILED=32.
findings.impact: Release PASS is not evidence of executed, fresh, source-bound qualification.
findings.false_positive_challenge: A later zero-failure JUnit and runtime identity equality were considered; neither closes generation/source/test binding or removes prefilled status.
findings.required_action: Replace declarations with executed producer results in a closed evidence envelope and rerun from a clean exact source.

findings.title: Project execution result can complete canonical tasks without observing repository state or resolving evidence
findings.counterexample: Fake head_after, no real Git HEAD, empty evidence and criteria plus caller PASS completed t1 and advanced to t2.
findings.impact: Canonical Project Memory and AUTO can advance beyond actual repository/test state.
findings.false_positive_challenge: Binding/command/correlation/project/task/plan/head_before checks are real; finding is narrowed to missing live-head/evidence/criterion observation.
findings.required_action: Resolve live repo HEAD and every evidence/criterion through authority before terminal task mutation.

findings.title: Project Memory and Catalog locks reclaim live owners by age alone
findings.counterexample: A lock owned by the current live PID with old mtime was deleted and a second owner entered in both implementations.
findings.impact: Concurrent canonical mutations can overlap and lose or corrupt logical state.
findings.false_positive_challenge: Atomic file publication was verified and narrows the defect to lock ownership; it does not restore mutual exclusion.
findings.required_action: Use OS-handle locks or incarnation-bound stable-handle/CAS ownership with cross-process tests.

findings.title: Project launch queue lock has unrecoverable partial-create liveness and ABA check-to-unlink
findings.counterexample: Corrupt one-hour-old lock was never reclaimable; separately a replacement inserted between compare and unlink was deleted and challenger acquired.
findings.impact: Permanent queue_busy or overlapping ownership after replacement race.
findings.false_positive_challenge: PID-dead plus lease logic protects some stale cases, but cannot repair corrupt create and cannot make read/path-unlink atomic.
findings.required_action: Move to OS-handle lock or implement durable record creation and stable compare-delete.

findings.title: Launch outbox recovery can erase a valid replacement and misses expired PUBLISHED projections
findings.reachability: Publication reachable; reconciler has zero production call sites
findings.counterexample: Reconciler checked orphan-a then erased replacement valid-b; after PUBLISHED projection expiry it rebuilt nothing and left status PUBLISHED.
findings.impact: Lost valid launch and AUTO stuck with a published claim but no consumable projection.
findings.false_positive_challenge: Sequential PENDING recovery and duplicate publish tests pass; they do not cover the failing interleaving or state asymmetry.
findings.required_action: Re-read/compare under lock, recover PUBLISHED-without-projection, wire reconciliation into startup/AUTO lifecycle.

findings.title: CURRENT documentation is stale relative to branch and overstates qualification
findings.counterexample: Document says NX071 NOT STARTED while three later commits and NX071 persisted evidence exist; it calls qualification source-bound despite F-001.
findings.impact: Operators receive stale work status and excessive assurance.
findings.false_positive_challenge: Document labels itself volatile and correctly separates source from ACTIVE; those strengths do not make NX071/qualification claims current.
findings.required_action: Regenerate CURRENT state after requalification and every lifecycle-changing cycle.

findings.title: Exact canonical authority artifacts are unavailable
findings.impact: Tasks, gates, acceptance criteria, invariants and transition order cannot be authoritatively mapped.
findings.false_positive_challenge: Repository CURRENT docs were inspected but deliberately not substituted for exact authority names.
findings.required_action: Supply exact files and rerun canonical mapping/completion validator.

root_causes.title: Declaration replaces measurement
root_causes.description: Gate output fields are initialized or declared and then asserted without closed data lineage to raw execution.

root_causes.title: Identifier replaces dereference
root_causes.description: Repository and evidence identities are stored as strings/statuses instead of resolved through authority before state mutation.

root_causes.title: Pathname replaces stable ownership
root_causes.description: Read/compare and unlink/write operate on a replaceable path; age/PID does not identify process incarnation.

root_causes.title: Recovery is not a lifecycle invariant
root_causes.description: Reconciler is not called by production lifecycle and does not repair PUBLISHED-without-projection.

root_causes.title: Authority and projection drift
root_causes.description: CURRENT projection lags implementation and exact canonical authority inputs are absent.
